Name: POSTURE_CONTROL_PARAM_WEP_RIGHT_ST
Description: Weapon posture twist for the weapon in the right hand, or for the weapon being two-handed (either hand). Each aNNN group is picked by the active weapon motion category: the right-hand weapon's one-handed motion ID when one-handing, or the two-handed weapon's two-handed motion ID; categories without a group (1, 4–9, 11) get no twist, and a missing row gives 0. Values are the maximum twist: the behaviour script scales them by a weight set by the current animation's TimeAct events and eases toward the result (up to 90 per second).

Fields.Name: [a000] Right Arm - Front/Back
Fields.Description: Right arm forward/back twist. When one-handing, using paired weapons or riding it moves the right arm forward/back; when two-handing it raises/lowers both arms. Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. 0 is no twist.

Fields.Name: [a000] Right Arm - Inside/Outside
Fields.Description: Right arm inward/outward twist while the active weapon motion category is 0. The chest armor's PostureControlParam_Pro value is used instead when its magnitude is larger. 0: no twist.

Fields.Name: [a000] Right Wrist - Front/Back
Fields.Description: Right wrist forward/back bend while the active weapon motion category is 0. 0: no bend.

Fields.Name: [a000] Right Wrist - Inside/Outside
Fields.Description: Right wrist inward/outward twist while the active weapon motion category is 0. 0: no twist.

Fields.Name: [a000] Right Weapon Rotation
Fields.Description: Rotation of the right-hand weapon while the active weapon motion category is 0. 0: none.

Fields.Name: [a000] Left Arm - Front/Back
Fields.Description: Left arm forward/back twist while the active weapon motion category is 0, used only while this right-hand weapon is held with both hands and is not a paired weapon (otherwise PostureControlParam_WepLeft supplies it). The chest armor's PostureControlParam_Pro value is used instead when its magnitude is larger. 0: none.
